target.name: install
target.note: install into the frozen prefix before check-world. macOS /bin/sh strips DYLD_* from the environment of the commands it runs, so the DESTDIR=tmp_install staging that `make check` performs cannot resolve the staged binaries' absolute install-name libraries over DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH: initdb aborts with 'Library not loaded: <prefix>/lib/libpq.5.dylib'. Populating the real prefix makes that path exist. This compiles nothing (world-bin already built everything); it is captured for completeness and so check-world is reproducible from a clean builddir+prefix.
